# California State University, Long Beach

> CSULB is a comprehensive public research university serving the Long Beach community with 75 years of academic excellence across multiple colleges and degree programs.

California State University, Long Beach (CSULB) is a major public university offering undergraduate and graduate programs, research opportunities, and community engagement initiatives. The university emphasizes social mobility, diversity, and economic development through its academic offerings and partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Admissions and Application Process
- Graduate Programs and Doctoral Degrees
- Student Life and Campus Experience
- Transfer Students
- Engineering and Research
- Academic Calendar and Deadlines
- Tuition and Financial Information

- University Library and Resources

- Sustainability
- Leadership Development
- Community Partnerships

## Admissions & Application

- [Apply](https://www.csulb.edu/apply): Application process for first-year, transfer, and graduate students
- [Admissions](https://www.csulb.edu/admissions): Admissions information for freshman, transfer, and graduate programs
- [Graduate Studies](https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-studies): Graduate programs including EDGE masters and doctoral degrees

## Academics & Programs

- [Colleges & Departments](https://www.csulb.edu/academic-affairs/colleges-departments): Directory of CSULB colleges, departments, and academic structure
- [Academic Affairs Calendar](https://www.csulb.edu/academic-affairs/academic-affairs-calendar): Academic calendar with semester dates, holidays, and deadlines
- [University Library](https://www.csulb.edu/university-library): University Library with OneSearch catalog and research databases
- [Office of Research and Economic Development](https://www.csulb.edu/office-of-research-and-economic-development): Research administration and scholarly activities support office

## Student Information & Support

- [Tuition and Fees](https://www.csulb.edu/student-records/tuition-and-fees): Tuition and fee breakdown for undergraduate and graduate students
